release_summary: Cherry's Chat 0.11.0: emoji in Say go out as symbols the game font can draw, or as :code: text when there is none, so the bubble over your head no longer shows empty boxes (the game draws bubbles itself, so pictures can't go in them). Global Bank 1.4.11: the Daily Rewards extension's page (1.0.13) shows every character's bag and bank as in game, with the game's own icons, and its Terminal tab runs the helper's commands, so viewing your bank no longer needs a terminal window. Real time for addons: the hub has a clock (CherrysClock), fed by Global Bank's Daily Rewards Chrome extension 1.0.9, whose local host writes Windows' time when Chrome starts. Cherry's Bar 1.1.8's Clock and ZShop 1.2.0-ck5 read it. Global Bank 1.4.7 follows the daily reset at 00:00 in Germany in any time zone, and its extension setup takes one click plus Chrome's two. Hub 0.4.24 stops single-addon installs from lighting the minimap's bug button. New separate packages: Cherry's Loginxml 1.2.0, a replacement login screen, and LogNextChar 1.2.0, Next and Prev character buttons. Everything else from the 0.11.100 playtest is included unchanged.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 932 tests; 906 passed and 26 retired-editor tests skipped. New tests cover decoding the game's icon formats, the game's slot layout, which pages may ask for bank data, icons and commands, reading icons from a fixture interface.fdb, and running the helper's commands as plain text. The page also ran on real Chrome 155 with a test profile and real saved data: 20 characters, icons, both tabs and Update now worked. Earlier checks from kit 0.11.101 still stand, and nothing from it has been confirmed in the game yet: docs/TESTING.md lists the checks. Unchanged addon packages keep their versions and byte-identical files.
